verdict.rationale: Gazebo's plugin architecture provides some hardware-abstraction-like capability — e.g. a 'plugin based interface to physics engines' (ODE, Bullet, DART) and plugins for 'robot, sensor, and environment control' — suggesting sensors/actuators can be swapped via plugin interfaces. However there is no evidence of a stable, documented sensor/actuator API contract that guarantees application code doesn't need rewriting when swapping hardware models. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a stable sensor/actuator abstraction API, real-hardware bring-up examples, independent confirmation that application code survives sensor/actuator swaps.
